Atom 0 on ligand 1 is the azine 4-methyl, so this is another 4-methyl product. Activity is capped and the cap ring is activity-neutral, so the honest play is to finish the cap scan on the geometry I actually use. On the para core an oxetane-3-carboxamide gave the best QED I have recorded, 0.905, by taking roughly a log unit off lipophilicity for the same ring size as a cyclobutyl - but it also cost 0.19 of SA, which is why it did not win there. The meta core starts from a better SA than the para one did, so the trade may come out differently here, and I have cyclopropyl, cyclobutyl and cyclopentyl measured or in flight on this core already. Adding the oxygen isostere completes that set and tells me which cap to default to from now on. Everything that carries activity - the conjugated anilide N-H, the meta geometry, the monocyclic azine with its ortho nitrogen and bare C3 and C6 - is untouched. Expected product: about 283 Da at LogP near 2.9.
